p_adnan_hijazi.overall: Newark resident under FBI surveillance who appears to act as a financier. The reports trace polished diamonds from Antwerp fence Pieter Dopple to him (worth about $47,000), cash deposits of almost the same amount ($47,980), and a $48,000 transfer to a scholarship fund that, on his instruction, paid $8,000 to each of six men. Those six men later booked paired cruises to the Bahamas. He also traveled to Madrid, Cairo (repeatedly visiting a jewelry shop at 411 Ramses St.) and Paris. The reports do not say what the money was for.

A search found a SCADA vulnerability study ("Black Ice") and e-bomb parts at his home. The reports suggest a possible plan to disrupt power infrastructure, perhaps with an electromagnetic pulse bomb.
